accuracy_interval: one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds per equation/mode; not simultaneous 95% two-sided
mc_below_target_multiple_testing: exact binomial P_p=.95(K<=observed k), Holm over all 26 equation/mode MC profiles
bias_intervals: t across independent seed means; Bonferroni over spatial points within each fixed profile
time_metric: cold response including setup/certificate; solver time separately; no runtime cutoff or PAR2
time_comparison: Welch log-time ratio 95% only for qualified profiles with complete observations; practical zone [1/1.1,1.1]; other ratios descriptive
